# EnterpriseGlue v0.28.0 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.27.6`.

## Highlights

- **developer-workflows:** Adds a Cloud staging-delivery skill and makes EnterpriseGlue status, shipping, and release watchers distinguish publication from actual staging and production state.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Reinstall enterpriseglue-dev-workflows 0.1.9 from the repository marketplace and start a new Codex task so the updated skills are loaded.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The staging workflow remains read-only unless the user explicitly requests a mutation, excludes the retired EE repository, and requires the protected receipt-bound Cloud workflow for tenant movement or release retirement.

## Documentation

- Updates the versioned Codex workflow plugin guide and the status, ship, post-ship, publication, and staging-delivery skills.

## Known limitations

- Reinstalling the plugin does not alter an already-running Codex task; open a new task to load the new skill version.

## Rollback

- Reinstall plugin version 0.1.8 to restore the previous skill set; this does not change repository or Cloud deployment state.

## Validation evidence

- The repository plugin contract tests, official Codex skill validator, official plugin validator, release-note checks, and documentation boundary guard pass locally.

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `cloud-staging-delivery-skills`
- Audiences: operators, developers
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
